questions.question: While camped at the Ahava canal, the leader of the returning exiles searched the people and priests. Which group did he find missing?
After the returning exiles fasted and prayed for a safe journey, God granted their request. True or false?
Before leaving for Jerusalem, what did the leader of the returning exiles weigh out to the priests and Levites for God's house?

answers.text: Silver and gold and sacred articles
Spears and shields for the road
Grain and oil for the altar
